DALLAS – It’s time to get spooky, sexy, and straight-up sensational! Join us for a one-of-a-kind Desi Halloween experience that fuses Bollywood beats, Punjabi energy, and haunted vibes like never before. Costumes are mandatory. Vibes are legendary.

🔥 MUSIC BY:
💣 DJ ASIM – One of the hottest names in the South Asian nightlife scene, DJ Dimple brings a powerhouse blend of Bollywood bangers, high-energy EDM drops, and Top 40 chart-toppers. Known for her electric stage presence and crowd energy, she’ll keep the dancefloor on fire all night long.
💣 DJ DHARK – A master of genre fusion and hypnotic rhythms, DJ Dhark is known for his signature sound — Techno grooves, Punjabi basslines, and underground Desi remixes. His immersive sets will transport you into a darker, sexier soundscape.

💀 WHAT TO EXPECT:
✨ Haunted dancefloor with Desi beats all night
✨ Costume Contest – Cash prizes + bottle giveaways
✨ Sinister light effects, fog machines, and eerie decor
✨ VIP sections + premium bottle service available
✨ The most lit Desi crowd in DFW
